title: AppleVLM: End-to-end Autonomous Driving with Advanced Perception and Planning-Enhanced Vision-Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating closed-loop driving performance metrics (such as Driving Score and Route Completion) and qualitatively analyzing lane oscillations with and without a Planning Strategy Encoder, demonstrating how explicit spatial features mitigate the ambiguity and misinterpretation of natural language navigation instructions.
